proposal.source: function parseToml(_cap, text) { const out = {}; let section = out; for (const raw of text.split(/\r?\n/)) { const line = raw.trim(); if (!line || line.startsWith('#')) continue; if (line.startsWith('[') && line.endsWith(']')) { const name = line.slice(1,-1).trim(); if (!name) throw new Error('invalid section'); section = out[name] || (out[name] = {}); continue; } const at = line.indexOf('='); if (at < 1) throw new Error('invalid assignment'); const key = line.slice(0,at).trim(); const value = line.slice(at+1).trim(); if (/^"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"$/.test(value)) section[key] = JSON.parse(value); else if (value === 'true' || value === 'false') section[key] = value === 'true'; else if (/^[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(value)) section[key] = Number(value); else throw new Error('unsupported TOML value'); } return out; }
proposal.description: Parse deterministic flat TOML scalars and one-level tables without effects.
